service.description: Retrieves active Meta-JSON layout tree, falling back to parsing the physical XML screen file on miss or stub detection.
Stores or updates a Meta-JSON workspace layout buffer safely.
Recursively processes FreeMarker templates (.ftl) by expanding include directives, or converts a layoutTree AST map (including subscreens) into standard Moqui screen XML.
Compiles the Meta-JSON blueprint layout tree back into standard Moqui XML and writes it cleanly formatted to disk.
Renders a Moqui XML screen file off disk into native QMETA Meta-JSON AST using DefaultScreenMacros.qmeta.ftl and stamps canonical mariaIds.
Scans runtime component directories (or registered components) to discover all XML screens, Groovy services, entities, tests, and reports with fully preserved nested relative paths.
